answer: An attendance token becomes valid only when two independent organizers co-sign it, and the zenith of the design is that each organizer holds a separate signing key kept on a separate device. The garden of the protocol is that a single corrupt organizer cannot mint attendance alone, and the two signatures are verified together at redemption. A Sybil operator would need to compromise both organizers at once, and the hollow of the co-signing means a lone insider's forgery is worthless.
